gitCommit.subject: Brand: the Dukan ledger mark replaces the D tile; the portal's favicon and manifest are Dukan's (2026-10-29)
gitCommit.body:
Brand: the Dukan ledger mark replaces the D tile; the portal's favicon and manifest are Dukan's (2026-10-29)

- ProductMark (portal header, the Dukan ERP page, the home page's product card,
  the legal pages) shows the interlocking-ledger mark, three named layers, in the
  theme's colours (--mark-left/right/highlight, light and dark), never mirrored.
- A portal build's favicon, apple-touch icon and manifest icons are the Dukan icon
  (opaque RGB); the TSX-MR company site keeps its own.
- Tests: dukan-brand (5); riyade and activity-console updated for the mark and the
  staff form on every business page.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
